description.value: Amramp is a wheelchair-ramp franchise offering the sale and rental of modular ramps plus related accessibility products and services (lifts, stairlifts, grab bars, home modifications). Per the 2025 FDD (issued June 9, 2025), the initial franchise fee is $49,250 per 1,000,000 territory residents, the estimated initial investment is $138,397 to $234,866, royalties run 3% to 12% of gross revenue with a 1%-3% Brand Fund fee, and the initial term is 10 years with one 10-year renewal. Territory is protected (not exclusive) for a typical population of about 2 million. Item 19 reports 2024 gross revenue for 60 outlets (58 franchised, 2 company-owned) ranging from $29,489 (partial year) to $2,791,553, with a median of about $347,578. The U.S. system had 54 outlets at end of 2024. No litigation or bankruptcy is disclosed; zero terminations 2022-2024.
